purpose: Head-driven RSI loop that rewrites the muse_bf16_proj kernel for this model's exact shapes. Every claim about speed comes from an okc job id; nothing else counts.

active_thread_objective.scope: Original full expert benchmark suite and independent holdouts; serving validation remains separate
active_thread_objective.projection_board_3000us: Intermediate projection challenge milestone, not completion of the full threefold objective

duties: writes exactly one candidate directory from the brief
never edits the incumbent, the ledger, or another candidate
runs python3 -m proj_rsi lint on the file before returning
reads the candidate for rule violations, graph safety, missing fallbacks, and wasted prepare time
wait, archive JSON/profile/log, record in the ledger

loop: profile current selected serving path; retain exact source/JIT, shape and hardware identity
measure same-run controls with all raw timings and complete correctness/state/terminal-output gates
write causal hypothesis, affected regions, expected score scenario, subjective probabilities and full cost
implement immutable version; record parent, composition requirements/conflicts and reversible delta
independent critic verifies exact executable closure and bounded driver before GPU admission
register reviewed job in durable ROI scheduler; root sole GPU launcher, one GPU slot
validate raw artifacts and cleanup; retain every signed result including tiny positives and invalid attempts
generalize after each validated success, failure or mixed result: preserve immutable facts separately from explanations, scope/transfer limits, confidence and falsification tests
retrieve relevant prior lessons before proposing the next experiment; create concrete follow-up ideas linked to lesson/evidence IDs and ROI queue entries
compare against actual selected serving incumbent; separately retain parent-relative progress
compose compatible gains into a concrete cumulative source, validate the whole stack and actual selected routes
only root releases official check/scoring after local validation, quota and source guards; archive immutable job ID and payload association
regenerate history tables; preserve unresolved or conflicting evidence and rank the next iteration

candidate_contract.self_validation: Every fast path proves itself in prepare() on the probe shapes (one-hot columns exact, random rows within tolerance) before it is enabled; a failing path is disabled, not shipped.
candidate_contract.bake_off: Validate and time actual candidates against applicable controls under graph replay with cold L2. Preserve all raw measurements and actual selections. Existing frozen sources may retain historical selection margins; new experiments need not impose a minimum gain. Whole-stack and official measurements decide promotion.
candidate_contract.fallback: cuBLAS/torch for BF16; FP32 matmul at m<=8 and the BF16 hi+lo pair above for the router. Odd m (5, 7, 9, 33, 130, 512, 1000) must go to a path that is correct; usually the fallback.
candidate_contract.no_regression: A path is only selected for a scored shape when it beats the fallback on that shape in the bake-off.
candidate_contract.rewrite_scope: Whole-kernel or stack redesigns are permitted. Byte-identical old SASS is a useful matched-control gate for narrow changes, not a universal requirement; broad rewrites compare to the immutable old source and must prove full correctness and measured final behavior.

gates.lint: python3 -m proj_rsi lint <file> has no errors
gates.check: okc check passes 9/9 and the 30 timed shapes
gates.promote_to_scored: After correctness/source/quota validation, submit the identical source when its official check point score is below the actual incumbent. User explicitly accepts every measured positive; no minimum effect-size or confidence-interval significance gate. Preserve uncertainty and all signed regressions.
gates.per_shape_win: yours_us below the incumbent's yours_us on that shape; losses on any scored shape are reported and the path reverts to the incumbent's choice in the next stitch

budget.rule: Never spend a check on a file that fails lint or whose fast paths are not guarded by the bake-off. Prefer one check carrying many variants over many checks carrying one.

rules: kernel_fn is CUDA-graph replayed: no host sync, no value-dependent allocation or branch, no printing tensors. Branching on m, n, k, layer is fine. Allocating the output is fine. Zeroing a prepare-time workspace is fine.
prepare() runs once, untimed, up to 300 s including nvcc. Compile and pack there.
BF16 weights stay BF16 or a lossless compression of it. The router's FP32 weights may be a BF16 hi+lo pair with FP32 accumulation. Dequantize in-kernel.
Nothing derived from data is cached. No reference import, no subprocess, no network, no harness introspection.
Correctness: relative L2 <= 1e-2 (router 1e-4), any row <= 5x that, probe rows (one-hot inputs) <= 1e-3, no NaN/Inf.
No okc login, no rules acceptance, no edits to rsi/, serving/, muse_moe_w4a16/.

shape_model.judge_overhead: yours_us is roughly kernel GPU time + 1.0-1.5 us after the judge subtracts about 4 us of replay cost; the practical floor for a tiny shape is about 2.5 us yours.

iteration_policy.scored_submission_rule: After source/correctness/graph/state checks pass and complete serving measurement improves, submit the cumulative candidate. User explicitly accepts small point-estimate improvements; no minimum microsecond/percentage or statistical-significance threshold.
iteration_policy.measurement_uncertainty: Record confidence intervals, conflicting estimators and comparator identity; uncertainty is reported, not an extra user approval gate.

required_fields: next ideas and linked ROI job IDs
learning_contract.execution: CPU learning work after physical cleanup, in parallel with the next admitted GPU trial. Hardware slot is never held just for prose.
learning_contract.proposal_rule: Each future idea lists applicable lesson IDs or an explicit no-relevant-prior-lesson reason; validate applicability, do not blindly repeat a conclusion.
learning_contract.retention: Failures and conflicting/tiny positives remain evidence. A failed version never closes an entire family.
learning_contract.submission: Learning is recorded alongside validation; it does not introduce a statistical-significance or extra user-confirmation gate for measured improvements.

hotpath_priority.authority: User: log actual hotpath, focus most repetitive/costly selected paths
hotpath_priority.ranking: Observed selected route + recoverable end-to-end cost weighted by exact benchmark aggregation, probability and full experiment cost. Raw callcount alone is not ROI.
required_experiment_context: timed complete path versus current incumbent
how change reaches actual selected path
hotpath_priority.trace_boundaries: Retain kernel counts/durations, copies, host sync, unprofiled timing separately. Static instruction counts or whole-kernel time do not establish sampled inner-loop bottlenecks.
hotpath_priority.exceptions: A proposed replacement for a selected hotpath remains eligible, but must name the incumbent it replaces. Correctness/setup repairs and bounded diagnostics are prerequisites, not performance gains.
hotpath_priority.scope_limits: Historical full-expert trace is not current full-model serving evidence. Projection3ms and original expert3x remain separate; fullmodel8GPU validation pending.
hotpath_priority.threshold: Retain every measured positive; this focus does not introduce a minimum gain threshold.
